name: Tomato Omelette
instructions: Beat the eggs, cook the chopped tomato and onion, pour the eggs over, add cheese and fold.

name: Scrambled Eggs on Toast
instructions: Scramble the eggs in butter and serve on toasted bread.

name: Cheese Quesadilla
instructions: Fill a tortilla with cheese, onion and pepper, then fry until crisp on both sides.

name: Pasta with Tomato Sauce
instructions: Simmer chopped tomato, garlic and onion into a sauce and toss with cooked pasta.

name: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Stir-fry the chicken and vegetables, add soy sauce and serve over rice.

name: Veggie Fried Rice
instructions: Fry the carrot and onion, add rice and egg, and season with soy sauce.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Butter the bread, add cheese between the slices and fry until golden.

name: Potato and Egg Hash
instructions: Fry diced potato, onion and pepper until soft, then crack the eggs on top.

name: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
instructions: Cook mushrooms and garlic, add cream and cheese, then toss with pasta.

name: Chicken Salad
instructions: Mix chopped cooked chicken with vegetables and mayonnaise.
